nodes.label: Implementor

fields.name: status
fields.description: READY FOR REVIEW only for a committed candidate with required implementation checks passing.

fields.name: candidate_sha
fields.description: Full committed task SHA; empty if no valid candidate.

fields.name: blockers
fields.description: Concrete blockers and decisions needed; empty when ready.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Concise changes, limitations and implementation evidence references.

fields.name: validation_evidence
fields.description: Absolute validation record paths belonging to this run.

nodes.label: Reviewer

fields.name: verdict
fields.description: APPROVED for the exact final validated SHA, CHANGES REQUIRED for work to return, BLOCKED when the flow must stop.

fields.name: final_task_sha
fields.description: Full final task tip after any Reviewer commits.

fields.name: approved_sha
fields.description: Full final task SHA only for APPROVED; empty otherwise.

fields.name: findings
fields.description: Standards and Spec outcomes; required findings separated from optional suggestions.

fields.name: blockers
fields.description: What prevents continuation and what unblocks it; empty if none.

fields.name: validation_evidence
fields.description: Absolute validation record paths belonging to this run.

fields.name: assignment_sha256
fields.description: Frozen assignment digest read from the shared record; binds approval to base/scope/check policy.
